name: Orbit
summary: Orbit is a subscription management app. Users add, track, and categorize their recurring subscriptions, view a calendar of upcoming charges, and receive renewal reminders. The core value proposition is visibility: showing users how much they spend annually on subscriptions they may have forgotten. The app offers a one-time lifetime purchase (Orbit Plus, $24.99) in addition to the free tier. The session reviewed onboarding, the subscription catalogue, calendar view, and settings.
